title: A new default for text on the main site
summary:
The main site now uses `nova-fast` by default for text.

The main site's default text model changed from `gemini-fast` to `nova-fast`.

highlights.title: Nova-fast by default
highlights.text: Text on the main site now defaults to `nova-fast` instead of `gemini-fast`. [Try it on pollinations.ai](https://pollinations.ai).
